name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
May 26, 2009
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Sister Madeline Fitzgerald, St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamations to outgoing Miss Teen Tri-City and Miss Pride of Vista and introduction of the new courts. (CC)
P2.
Presentation by Erin Wong and Scott Chikuami regarding the 2009 San Diego County Fair.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Revisions to City Council Policy 700-07, Investment of City Funds (CC/CDC)
C4.
Disadvantaged Business Enterprise Program (CC)
C5.
Local Investigations and Studies Assistance Program Grant Funding Agreements (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving an agreement with the San Diego County Water Authority for Receipt of Local Investigations and Study Assistance Program grant funding;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving an agreement with Post, Buckley, Schuh & Jernigan, Inc., d/b/a PBS&J for wastewater engineering services;
3.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2009- , approving an agreement with the Chartered City of Vista for reimbursement of wastewater engineering services consultant costs for Buena Sanitation District projects; and
4.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving an agreement with the Buena Sanitation District for reimbursement of wastewater engineering services consultant costs for Buena Sanitation District projects.
C6.
Regional Computer Aided Dispatch (CAD) Interoperability Project (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving the Thinkstream, Inc., and City of Vista Regional CAD Interoperability Project Professional Services Agreement;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving the Private-Public Partnership Agreement between the San Diego Urban Area and Thinkstream, Inc.; and
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving the Memorandum of Understanding for the San Diego Urban Area Regional CAD Interoperability Project.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Regional Transportation Improvement Plan - Amendment (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony, close the public hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , adopting an amendment to the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program for Projects for Fiscal Years 2009 through 2013.
PH2.
CDBG-R 2008/09 Substantial Amendment (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony, close the public hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving a substantial amendment to the 2008/09 Annual Action Plan to apply for CDBG-R funding under the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009, authorizing the submittal of the substantial amendment to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, and authorizing the City Manager to approve and execute all forms.
DISCUSSION
D1.
Draft Fiscal Year 2009/10 Operating Budget (CC/BSD/CDC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
